clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau tells the story of young soldiers in Vietnam, given chlorine tablets to purify river water from their canteens.

The tablets worked, no dysentery. But when some of those soldiers were later autopsied, surgeons were stunned to find 70-80% blockages in their heart's arteries, after only six or seven months of drinking that water.

His point: chlorine itself scars the artery wall, and the body's LDL keeps patching that damage until the artery clogs.

His fix for tap water at home: a whole-house filter that pulls the chlorine out, or spring water instead.

clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau tells the story of asking a Harvard-trained cardiologist to run a full heart scan, just to check, with no symptoms at all.

The results: perfect circulation, like an 18-year-old. Near-zero calcification in the arteries, like a teenager. A resting heart rate like an athlete. Perfect blood pressure.

The doctor's response: he was still going to prescribe the cholesterol-lowering drug anyway, because one blood number read 225 - and he said he had to put the recommendation in writing regardless.

Kevin's reaction: "It's sad, but I get it."
